name: Senate Leadership Fund
summary: Senate Republicans' main super PAC, founded in January 2015 by allies of Mitch McConnell and now aligned with Majority Leader John Thune. Its affiliated nonprofit One Nation, which does not disclose donors, has passed it tens of millions of dollars. It spent $296.6 million in the 2024 cycle. In the 2026 cycle Elon Musk became its biggest donor, giving $158 million that it passed on to Texas PAC, the main outside backer of Ken Paxton's losing Senate run.
